description: This file defines an internal interface 'IPubSubRendezvousGrain' for pub/sub rendezvous functionality within Orleans Streams. It includes methods for registering and unregistering producers and consumers, querying subscription counts, diagnostics, validation, retrieving subscriptions, and fault handling.

classes.name: IPubSubRendezvousGrain
classes.description: Internal interface for pub/sub rendezvous operations in Orleans Streams, extending IGrainWithStringKey.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specified stream ID.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specified stream ID.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with a subscription ID, stream ID, and optional filter data.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer based on subscription ID and stream ID.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a stream ID.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a stream ID.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumers
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about consumers for a stream ID.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the state or configuration of the rendezvous.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream ID, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulty based on its subscription ID.
